revisions.title: Saved revision 1
revisions.description: Detailed naval battleship featuring three heavy triple gun turrets in a 2-forward 1-aft superfiring configuration, rich teak wooden deck, multi-tiered armored bridge tower, raked smokestacks, secondary 5-inch twin batteries, AA gun tubs, and a stern aircraft catapult with reconnaissance floatplane.
